BiblicalUsage: Epiphanes means notable, conspicuous, memorable — and Peter quotes Joel: the sun shall be turned into darkness and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come.
TheologicalSignificance: A day so great it darkens the sun is worth the warning, and the only safe place on it is calling on the name of the Lord.
RelatedTopics: Day of the Lord; Judgment; Prophecy
